title: The human being – Allah’s most beautiful creation
intro: Allah created us in the most beautiful way and gave us a mind. How should we live on Earth?

learn.text: We have certainly created man in the best of stature;
While He has created you in stages?

learn.html: The human being is Allah’s most beautiful and most perfect creation. That is why we praise Allah:

learn.text: So blessed is Allah, the best of creators.

learn.alt: A baby curled up before it is born

learn.text: He creates you in the wombs of your mothers, creation after creation

learn.alt: A man looking ahead and thinking

learn.html: Allah gave the human being something special, more than all other creatures: a mind (‘aql). And He made us His caretakers on Earth (khalifah).

learn.title: 🧠 Did you know?
learn.html: Your brain has about 100 billion nerve cells – about as many as there are stars in our galaxy! Messages travel between them at more than 400 km/h (250 mph), and about 70,000 thoughts go through your brain every day.
We should live on Earth responsibly and in obedience to Allah, the Most High. Allah says:

learn.text: And I did not create the jinn and mankind except to worship Me.

practice.title: Gifts from Allah
practice.prompt: Tap everything Allah gave us, then tap Check.

options.text: 📱 A phone we were born with
options.why: Nobody is born with a phone – people make phones. Our body and our mind are Allah’s gifts.

questions.q: How did Allah create the human being?
options: In the best and most beautiful way

questions.q: Who is Allah’s most beautiful creation?
What special gift did Allah give the human being?
What did Allah make the human being on Earth?
How should we live on Earth?

practice.title: At home and in the maktab
prompts: 💬 Say together: “So blessed is Allah, the best of creators.”
